100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1532BR-357-3SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2110MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-GAP-ACCOUNTSegment 100 shall contain the account number or identification value required by the transaction context.Non-TransArmor Subsequent Transaction Request Account Number is variable length up to 24 alphanumeric bytes.
100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1533BR-357-4SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2111MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-APPAA-EXPIRATION-TOKEN-PERSISTENCEOn subsequent TransArmor transactions, the unencrypted expiration date shall be sent in Card Discretionary Block Data (Element 12) as for non-TransArmor transactions, and the TransArmor token returned in the initial transaction response shall be used in the Account Number field of subsequent transactions.Non-TransArmor Subsequent Transaction Response Account Number is fixed 25 alphanumeric bytes.
100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1534BR-357-5SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2112MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-APPAA-ACCOUNT-FORMATFor TransArmor processing, Account Number (Element 2) shall use the TAP header format TAPnnnnnnxyyyyyyyyyyyzzzz[EDATA]: 3-byte TAP indicator, 6-byte sequence number matching Element 86, 1-byte EDATA identifier, 11-byte Key ID, 4-byte Token Type ID, and EDATA of no more than 400 bytes.For TransArmor (either encryption method), the Account Number field identifies the 25-byte TransArmor header plus a 400-byte EDATA block containing encrypted/unencrypted account-identifying information.
100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1535BR-357-6SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2113MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-APPAA-EXPIRATION-TOKEN-PERSISTENCEOn subsequent TransArmor transactions, the unencrypted expiration date shall be sent in Card Discretionary Block Data (Element 12) as for non-TransArmor transactions, and the TransArmor token returned in the initial transaction response shall be used in the Account Number field of subsequent transactions.For non-TransArmor and TransArmor Token Only, the POS device maintains the card's Account Number until it receives a response from the host.
100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1536BR-357-7SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2114MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-APPAA-EXPIRATION-TOKEN-PERSISTENCEOn subsequent TransArmor transactions, the unencrypted expiration date shall be sent in Card Discretionary Block Data (Element 12) as for non-TransArmor transactions, and the TransArmor token returned in the initial transaction response shall be used in the Account Number field of subsequent transactions.For TransArmor PKI Encryption and Tokenization, the POS device must not maintain the card's Account Number after the initial card swipe.
100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1537BR-357-8SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2115MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-APPAA-EXPIRATION-TOKEN-PERSISTENCEOn subsequent TransArmor transactions, the unencrypted expiration date shall be sent in Card Discretionary Block Data (Element 12) as for non-TransArmor transactions, and the TransArmor token returned in the initial transaction response shall be used in the Account Number field of subsequent transactions.For Non-TransArmor and TransArmor, when the Account Number is read from a Track 2 card reader, Account Number and Card Discretionary Block Data consist of all data between (but not including) the Start Sentinel and End Sentinel; Account Number is the data before the '=' character and Card Discretionary Block Data is the data after the '=' character. The '=' is used instead of a Field Separator.
100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1538BR-357-9SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2116MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-APPN-TRACK2-ACCOUNTPremium Gift Card Track II data shall contain a 16-digit Account Number using the assigned Premium Gift Card BIN structure.Track 1 card reader source for Account Number is applicable to credit cards only.
100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1539BR-358-1SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2117MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-APPN-TRACK2-ACCOUNTPremium Gift Card Track II data shall contain a 16-digit Account Number using the assigned Premium Gift Card BIN structure.For Non-TransArmor, Account Number and Card Discretionary Block Data combined must not exceed 76 bytes for Track 1 or 37 bytes for Track 2.
100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1540BR-358-2SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2118MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-APPAD-ACCOUNT-DEPENDENCYReal Time Account Updater processing depends on Account Number (Element 2) and Card Discretionary Block Data (Element 12) content and shall be validated jointly with those fields.For TransArmor (either encryption method), Account Number and Card Discretionary Block Data combined must not exceed 476 bytes for Track 1 or Track 2.
100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1541BR-358-3SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2119MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-APPAA-EXPIRATION-TOKEN-PERSISTENCEOn subsequent TransArmor transactions, the unencrypted expiration date shall be sent in Card Discretionary Block Data (Element 12) as for non-TransArmor transactions, and the TransArmor token returned in the initial transaction response shall be used in the Account Number field of subsequent transactions.Account Number is the data before the first ^ character and Card Discretionary Block Data is the data after the first ^ character; the ^ character is used instead of a Field Separator.
100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1542BR-358-4SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2120MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-APPAD-ACCOUNT-DEPENDENCYReal Time Account Updater processing depends on Account Number (Element 2) and Card Discretionary Block Data (Element 12) content and shall be validated jointly with those fields.Track data placed in the combined data elements of Account Number and Card Discretionary Block Data cannot exceed the total length of those data elements.
100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1543BR-358-5SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2121MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-APPAA-EXPIRATION-TOKEN-PERSISTENCEOn subsequent TransArmor transactions, the unencrypted expiration date shall be sent in Card Discretionary Block Data (Element 12) as for non-TransArmor transactions, and the TransArmor token returned in the initial transaction response shall be used in the Account Number field of subsequent transactions.When a merchant receives Account Updater Card Number (New PAN) in Segment 155 in the original transaction response, the merchant may send either the new PAN or the original PAN in follow-on transactions in the Account Number field.
100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1544BR-358-6SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2122MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-APPAA-EXPIRATION-TOKEN-PERSISTENCEOn subsequent TransArmor transactions, the unencrypted expiration date shall be sent in Card Discretionary Block Data (Element 12) as for non-TransArmor transactions, and the TransArmor token returned in the initial transaction response shall be used in the Account Number field of subsequent transactions.When a merchant receives Account Updater TransArmor Token (New TransArmor Token) in Segment 155 in the original transaction response, the merchant may send either the new or original TransArmor token in follow-on transactions in the Account Number field as TAP request.
100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1545BR-358-7SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2123MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-APPAA-EXPIRATION-TOKEN-PERSISTENCEOn subsequent TransArmor transactions, the unencrypted expiration date shall be sent in Card Discretionary Block Data (Element 12) as for non-TransArmor transactions, and the TransArmor token returned in the initial transaction response shall be used in the Account Number field of subsequent transactions.In the event of a Retry of a follow-on transaction (Reversals, Completions, Cancellations, Void of Merchandise Return, and Timeout reversals), the merchant should use the same credentials for the retry as were used in the initial attempt.
100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1546BR-358-8SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2124MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-GAP-ACCOUNTSegment 100 shall contain the account number or identification value required by the transaction context.For Stored Value cards, the length of the Account Number must be 16 or 19 bytes.
100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1547BR-358-9SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2125MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-APPN-TRACK2-ACCOUNTPremium Gift Card Track II data shall contain a 16-digit Account Number using the assigned Premium Gift Card BIN structure.For a First Data Premium Gift Card Transaction Response, the calculated card number is returned in the Account Number field.
100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1548BR-358-10SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2126MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-GAP-ACCOUNTSegment 100 shall contain the account number or identification value required by the transaction context.For credit, debit, and EBT cards, valid Account Number codes/values are defined in the most recent BUYPASS Platform Issuer Identification Number (IIN) Reference Manual; Fleet cards use the BUYPASS Platform Petroleum Industry Processing Specifications.
100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1549BR-359-1SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2127MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-APPAA-EXPIRATION-TOKEN-PERSISTENCEOn subsequent TransArmor transactions, the unencrypted expiration date shall be sent in Card Discretionary Block Data (Element 12) as for non-TransArmor transactions, and the TransArmor token returned in the initial transaction response shall be used in the Account Number field of subsequent transactions.For Check Services (SCAN/ETC and ECA/TeleCheck), all MICR data (scanned or manually entered) up to 23 bytes must be included in the Account Number field and must also be included in MICR Data (Element No. 122) of the Check Data Segment (Segment No. 110).
100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1550BR-359-2SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2128MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-GAP-ACCOUNTSegment 100 shall contain the account number or identification value required by the transaction context.For Certegy (formerly Telecredit) check service, Account Number positions 1â€“24 must contain the driver's license.
100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1551BR-359-3SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2129MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-GAP-ACCOUNTSegment 100 shall contain the account number or identification value required by the transaction context.For a Loyalty Totals Request (Update Code value 'T'), the literal text 'TOTALS REQUEST' must appear in the Account Number field.
100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1552BR-359-4SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2130MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-GAP-ACCOUNTSegment 100 shall contain the account number or identification value required by the transaction context.For any loyalty advice transaction other than a Totals Request, the Account Number must contain the actual Loyalty Account Number.
100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1553BR-359-5SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2131MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-APPN-TRACK2-ACCOUNTPremium Gift Card Track II data shall contain a 16-digit Account Number using the assigned Premium Gift Card BIN structure.For an Express Code request (Card Type code 095), the 25-digit Express Code value must appear in the Account Number area.
100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1554BR-359-6SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2132MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-APPN-TRACK2-ACCOUNTPremium Gift Card Track II data shall contain a 16-digit Account Number using the assigned Premium Gift Card BIN structure.For a ComCheck request (Card Type code 096), the 10-digit Check Value must appear in the Account Number area.
100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1555BR-359-7SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2133MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-APPN-TRACK2-ACCOUNTPremium Gift Card Track II data shall contain a 16-digit Account Number using the assigned Premium Gift Card BIN structure.For a Money Code/Check request (Card Type code 093), the 10-21 digit Money Code Value must appear in the Account Number area.
100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1558BR-361-1SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2136MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-GAP-APPROVALApproval Number shall be validated when the transaction flow requires an approval reference.Approval Number is required on reversals for matching information to the original purchase.
100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1559BR-361-2SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2137MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-GAP-APPROVALApproval Number shall be validated when the transaction flow requires an approval reference.If Approval Number is included in a Purchase Request, the Purchase Request is considered preauthorized and BUYPASS does not go out for authorization.
100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1560BR-361-3SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2138MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-GAP-APPROVALApproval Number shall be validated when the transaction flow requires an approval reference.In an Authorization Only Reversal, the Approval Number present in the original transaction must be present and identical in the Authorization Only Reversal transaction.

100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1562BR-361-5SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2140MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-GAP-APPROVALApproval Number shall be validated when the transaction flow requires an approval reference.Approval Number is fixed length 6 alphanumeric bytes, space-filled; valid values are any alphanumeric representation including spaces.
100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1566BR-361-9SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2144MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-E121-002Partial Approval Indicator value 5 requires Amex prepaid balance-receipt context.For a Partial Approval transaction, the approved amount is in the Approved Amount field, and the POS device must prompt for payment of the remaining balance due.
100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1574BR-364-1SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2152MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-APPAA-EXPIRATION-TOKEN-PERSISTENCEOn subsequent TransArmor transactions, the unencrypted expiration date shall be sent in Card Discretionary Block Data (Element 12) as for non-TransArmor transactions, and the TransArmor token returned in the initial transaction response shall be used in the Account Number field of subsequent transactions.If the Account Number is obtained from a Track 2 card reader (not manually keyed), the Account Number and Card Discretionary Block Data must consist of all data read between (but not including) the Start Sentinel and End Sentinel, with Account Number being data before the '=' character and Card Discretionary Block Data being data after; '=' is used instead of a Field Separator.
100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1575BR-364-2SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2153MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-APPAA-EXPIRATION-TOKEN-PERSISTENCEOn subsequent TransArmor transactions, the unencrypted expiration date shall be sent in Card Discretionary Block Data (Element 12) as for non-TransArmor transactions, and the TransArmor token returned in the initial transaction response shall be used in the Account Number field of subsequent transactions.If the Account Number is obtained from a Track 1 card reader (credit cards only, not manually keyed), the Account Number and Card Discretionary Block Data must consist of all unaltered data read between (but not including) the Start Sentinel and End Sentinel, with Account Number being data before the first '^' character and Card Discretionary Block Data being data after; '^' is used instead of a Field Separator.
100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1576BR-364-3SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2154MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-APPN-TRACK2-ACCOUNTPremium Gift Card Track II data shall contain a 16-digit Account Number using the assigned Premium Gift Card BIN structure.Account Number and Card Discretionary Block Data combined must not exceed 76 characters for Track 1 or 37 characters for Track 2.
100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1577BR-364-4SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2155MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-APPAD-ACCOUNT-DEPENDENCYReal Time Account Updater processing depends on Account Number (Element 2) and Card Discretionary Block Data (Element 12) content and shall be validated jointly with those fields.Track data placed in the combined data elements of Account Number and Card Discretionary Block Data cannot exceed the total length of those data elements.
100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1578BR-364-5SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2156MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-APPAA-EXPIRATION-TOKEN-PERSISTENCEOn subsequent TransArmor transactions, the unencrypted expiration date shall be sent in Card Discretionary Block Data (Element 12) as for non-TransArmor transactions, and the TransArmor token returned in the initial transaction response shall be used in the Account Number field of subsequent transactions.For either TransArmor processing method, the expiration date must be included in Card Discretionary Block Data; the expiration date is stored for follow-on transactions associated with a Token.
100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1579BR-364-6SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2157MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-APPAA-EXPIRATION-TOKEN-PERSISTENCEOn subsequent TransArmor transactions, the unencrypted expiration date shall be sent in Card Discretionary Block Data (Element 12) as for non-TransArmor transactions, and the TransArmor token returned in the initial transaction response shall be used in the Account Number field of subsequent transactions.When a merchant receives Account Updater Expiration Date (New Expiration Date) in the original transaction response in the Real Time Account Updater Response Segment (Segment 155), the merchant may send either the new expiration date or the original expiration date in follow-on transactions in the Card Discretionary Block Data field.
100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1580BR-364-7DIRECT_SEGMENT_100SCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2158MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-APPAA-EXPIRATION-TOKEN-PERSISTENCEOn subsequent TransArmor transactions, the unencrypted expiration date shall be sent in Card Discretionary Block Data (Element 12) as for non-TransArmor transactions, and the TransArmor token returned in the initial transaction response shall be used in the Account Number field of subsequent transactions.The merchant should send the Expiration Date corresponding to the original PAN or the new PAN / the original or new TransArmor Token that is being sent in the cardholder Account Number field (Data Element 2) in the Standard Message Data Segment 100.
100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1593BR-367-3SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2171MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-APPE-PROMPT-COMPOSITIONA financial Prompt Code shall combine a valid Appendix G transaction type with a valid Appendix E financial card type.In a financial transaction, the device sends the Card Type code to the host as part of the 4-character Prompt Code.

100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1597BR-368-2SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2175MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-GAP-CASH-AMOUNTCash Amount shall represent the total cash amount when cash data applies.If a merchant chooses to support Interlink's Optional Cash Back Fee, the Cash Amount field includes the total of the cash back amount and the cash back fee.
100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1598BR-368-3SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2176MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-GAP-CASH-AMOUNTCash Amount shall represent the total cash amount when cash data applies.Cash Amount is variable length up to eight digits with two assumed decimal places; valid values 1â€“99999999.
100REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:1623BR-375-1SEGMENT_100_FIELD_RULESCENARIO_REVIEW_REQUIREDSC-2201MATCHED_ELEMENT_AND_SEMANTICSMatched: shared source element and semantic evidence met the confirmed heuristic threshold; validate business meaning before acceptance.BR-SEG100-GAP-PINEncrypted PIN Block Data shall use the source-defined DUKPT KSN and PIN-block representation when PIN processing applies.Encrypted PIN Block Data is required for debit and EBT transactions but not required for a completion.
